title: Validate the full physical-phone shopping flow and real dictation
source: Existing BACKLOG.md QA-001 row; selected with all non-REL-001 work on 2026-11-07.
finding: Coverage and physical acceptance task, not an observed application defect.
automated_coverage: tests/INTERACTIONS.md maps model, actual-control Windows, real desktop VKB and isolated native Android coverage. Existing entry, Back, reset/cleanup and Undo recovery tests cover app mechanics; they do not establish real dictation or one-handed store use.
current_work: Completed the available app-side validation and added native shopping single/double-tap, short/full mode pulls in both modes, no-checked Remove and cold System-selection controls to the existing entry driver. Physical acceptance remains pending.

verification.entry: out/remaining/android-entry-expanded/results.json: all 36 native records pass using actual Gboard/Return, control-driven edits, catalog lifecycle, Undo, checked-row controls and the 8 added cases. Exact saved identity/order/checks are retained; no microphone is activated.
verification.back: out/remaining/android-back-current/results.json and android-back-right-current/results.json: 13 checks per edge pass, including layer priority, live background/return and saved contents.
verification.gesture_helper_control: out/remaining/android-back-helper-control/results.json: 14 checks pass, including deliberate reorder/restore, cancelled-edge recovery and next swipe/correction. The helper's existing default 150 ms movement behavior is retained; the new duration argument is optional for held selector setup.
verification.windows: out/remaining/windows-controls.txt: flow 19, keyboard 6 and model 104 records pass. Full unchanged Windows suites were not repeated for this test/documentation work.

remaining: Actual one-handed physical shopping flow using the current build.
Real speech/dictation with quantities/punctuation in the normal language; record recognized versus saved text and keyboard continuity.
limitations: No physical device was connected at the 2026-11-07 device inventory. Automated scripts target only emulator-5580 and never activate the microphone. No phone installation or physical/speech acceptance is claimed.
closure_criteria: Record the physical shopping and real dictation results in reviews/QA-001.md, in addition to the repeatable app-side checks. Keep unsupported recognizer/device claims explicit.
